question: Which of the following committees was set up to investigate into the infamous Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hunter Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Hunter Committee was formed by the British government in 1919 to investigate the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
 
• The committee was named after Lord William Hunter, who was the chairman of the investigative panel.
 
• The committee consisted of both British and Indian members, aiming to provide a comprehensive investigation.
